It is stated that the valuation of the suit, as indicated in the appeal is Rs. 5,01,000.00/- which is below the prescribed limit of valuation by this Court and this Court generally entertains appeal up to the valuation of Rs. 20,00,000/- or above.

Mr. Goswami, learned counsel for the appellant submitted that he may be permitted to withdraw this appeal and with a liberty to file the same before appropriate Court and he also prays for granting him 3 (three) days time.
Accordingly, taking note of the submission of learned counsel for the appellants, this F.A.O. stands disposed of on withdrawal.
However, liberty is granted to the appellants to approach the appropriate forum by filing appropriate petition within 16.06.2025.
